title: RL Post-training
description: Training progress, rollout timing and Megatron updates for sync and async runs. Select the training type, run, job and executions to inspect. Panels labelled run-wide cover the whole run. Missing telemetry is unknown.

params.value: SELECT run_id AS value FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND name IN ('lifecycle', 'policy_step', 'rollout_call') AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND run_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY run_id HAVING (CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN json_get(resource_attributes_json, 'training_type') = 'async' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'async' ELSE 'sync' END) = ${training_type:sqlstring} ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

SELECT job_id AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring})) GROUP BY job_id HAVING job_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

SELECT execution_uid AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM "telemetry_v1.marinskyrl" WHERE service = 'marinskyrl' AND timestamp_ms >= CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{from}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND timestamp_ms < CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM {{to}}) * 1000 AS BIGINT) AND COALESCE(NULLIF("cluster", ''), 'marin') IN (${cluster:sqlstring}) AND run_id IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND job_id IN (${job:sqlstring})) GROUP BY execution_uid HAVING execution_uid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAX(timestamp_ms) DESC

panels.title: Optimizer step, synced and producing policy
panels.description: Per-bucket maximum of the optimizer step, the model version completed by weight sync, and the producing policy version on completed work, with one series per execution. The producing version comes from the work record; the synced version needs trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Generated and consumed response tokens / s
panels.description: Per-second rate of work_completed token counts for generated_token, consumed_response_token and consumed_loss_token, summed per bucket. Generation workers record generated tokens when a group finishes; the trainer records consumed tokens after each optimizer step. The generated-token series is always on; the two consumed-token series need trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Rollouts and samples completed
panels.description: Rollouts and samples completed in each bucket. A rollout is one completed trajectory; a sample is one generated response segment. These are counter deltas.

panels.title: Process lifecycle and terminal export counts
panels.description: The latest lifecycle event for each selected execution, with exported, lost and queued record counts from its terminal event. A missing terminal event leaves the counts empty.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Services reporting this run
panels.description:
One row per service, role and metric source that stamped this run id, with the time each last reported.

A healthy run shows several marinskyrl rows, one vllm row, and one harbor row. A missing row is the only evidence that a service failed to start telemetry.

The Iris node agent never appears here, because it stamps no run id. Rows come from the marinskyrl, vllm and harbor tables in telemetry_v1.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No services under this run_id in this window.

panels.title: Span coverage: clock domain and failed steps
panels.description: Distinct observed steps per role and clock domain across the selected executions, with the count whose span ended in failure. The failed-step count is unknown when no span carries an outcome stamp.

defaults.noValue: No spans. The run reported a policy_step, so the trainer's timing sink is not reaching Finelog.

panels.title: Exporter and nonfinite observations
panels.description: Per process: summed training_nonfinite_values, and the max cumulative telemetry_lost_records / telemetry_rejected_records exporter gauges. The nonfinite counter comes from record_training_metrics; the exporter gauges are native to the telemetry pipeline. The nonfinite series needs trainer.training_metrics; the exporter gauges are always on.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Where the step's wall clock goes
Driver step, preparation and policy walls
panels.description: Mean phase_duration_seconds for the driver's step, wait_for_generation_buffer, run_training, fwd_logprobs_values_reward and train_critic_and_policy phases, per bucket. Each is a Timer span the trainer publishes after every step. Always on when telemetry is configured; step, run_training and train_critic_and_policy are nested, so never add them.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Step composition: exclusive seconds per span
panels.description: Mean seconds per optimizer step, split into the time each driver span spent outside its child spans. The bands for each execution sum to its mean step wall time in the bucket. A negative band indicates inconsistent parent and child timing observations.

defaults.noValue: No inclusive-wall driver rows under root='step'. This build publishes no step timings.

panels.title: Rollout wait vs train step (critical path)
panels.description:
Mean seconds per optimizer step the trainer spent waiting for rollouts, and inside the step itself.

Rollout wait above train step means generation is the bottleneck.

Both spans contain everything inside them, so they never stack. Each series is split by outcome, because a phase that failed recorded only how long it ran before failing. Blank means no critical-path spans arrived. Data from telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

panels.title: Straggler proxy: rollout wait p99 ÷ p50
panels.description:
The 99th percentile of the trainer's rollout wait divided by its median over steps in each 30-minute bucket. This measures step-to-step spread across executions of the run. A partial bucket uses the steps inside the selected window.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

panels.title: Weight sync and policy offload walls
panels.description: Mean phase_duration_seconds for sync_weights, init_weight_sync_state, offload_policy_model_to_cpu and update_ref_with_policy, split by outcome and execution. sync_weights times broadcast_to_inference_engines; the rest time the one-time sync-state setup and the optimizer offload around it. Always on when telemetry is configured; these are elapsed waits and do not measure GPU kernel time.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Weight-sync stages
panels.description: async_phase_window intervals for phase=training and weight_sync, plus a 1 ms marker at each weight_sync_completed event, per execution. The trainer opens and closes the phase windows around each step and the loop's weight sync. Empty without trainer.rollout_spans for the intervals, or trainer.training_metrics for the completion marks.

panels.title: Generation worker await duration
panels.description: Mean and max rollout_wait_seconds by wait name (prompt, slot, enqueue, model_client_await, env_await), the mean normalized by rollout_waits. Generation workers record these inside TrajectoryRunner.run(), including the wait on AsyncStalenessManager.acquire_submission_slot(). Empty without trainer.rollout_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Completed buffer depth and capacity
panels.description: Latest rollout_queue_depth and rollout_capacity gauges per bucket: the GenerationOutputGroupBuffer's occupancy against trainer.fully_async.max_buffered_groups. The trainer updates both whenever a group enters or leaves the buffer. Always on when telemetry is configured; sampled zeros can miss short occupancy bursts.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Buffer dwell of trained groups
panels.description: p50/p95/max of rollout_buffer_dwell_seconds for groups with disposition=consumed: time from group completion to trainer admission. Recorded when a consumed group leaves the GenerationOutputGroupBuffer. Empty without trainer.rollout_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Successful rollout-call latency
panels.description: p50/p95/max of phase_duration_seconds for phase=rollout_call: the wall time of one successful TrajectoryRunner.run() call. Recorded by observe_rollout_call around each generation-worker rollout. Empty without trainer.rollout_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Driver event-loop lag
panels.description: Max event_loop_lag_seconds per bucket: how late the driver's asyncio loop ran past its scheduled tick. Sampled once a second by monitor_event_loop_lag on the trainer's event loop. Empty without trainer.rollout_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Signed timing residuals
panels.description:
Minimum signed rollout-call residual per execution and minimum Megatron policy-update residual across ranks in each bucket. A residual is wall time not assigned to named child phases. Negative values indicate overlapping timing observations and remain signed. Rollout residuals need trainer.rollout_spans; Megatron residuals need trainer.policy_train_spans.

Megatron phases are CPU wall time around asynchronous CUDA launches (`clock_domain=cpu_dispatch_wall`), so a phase can end before its GPU work does.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Rollouts completing during policy training
panels.description: Successful rollout_call events whose finish falls inside an async_phase_window phase=training interval, grouped by optimizer step. Both are driver-recorded with explicit start/finish timestamps and joined on overlap. Empty without trainer.rollout_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Group dispositions / bucket
panels.description: Per-bucket sum of rollout_groups: the count of groups reaching each terminal disposition (consumed, rejected, stale_enqueue, shutdown-pending). Recorded once per group when record_group_disposition closes it out. Empty without trainer.rollout_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Tokens by group disposition / bucket
panels.description: Per-bucket sum of rollout_group_tokens: response tokens attached to each terminal group disposition. Recorded alongside rollout_groups by record_group_disposition. Empty without trainer.rollout_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Inference sampled throughput by learner phase
panels.description: vLLM generation_tokens_total / prompt_tokens_total counter deltas, rated per covered second and joined to async_phase_window driver phases. The vLLM engines export the counters independently; the trainer emits the phase windows to join against. Empty without trainer.rollout_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching observations

panels.title: Staleness (async runs; a sync run shows staleness 0 only)
Policy staleness at training
panels.description:
p50/p95/max of rollout_staleness_steps: how many optimizer steps behind the model was when each admitted group was consumed. The trainer records one observation per group against max_staleness_steps. Always on when telemetry is configured; rejected groups are excluded.

A sync run shows staleness 0 only.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Staleness of trained groups: groups per step
panels.description:
Count of rollout_staleness_steps observations per optimizer step, split by staleness value: how many admitted groups landed at each staleness. The trainer records one observation per group in record_rollout_staleness. Always on when telemetry is configured; rejected groups are excluded.

A sync run shows staleness 0 only.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Staleness of trained groups: tokens per step
panels.description:
Sum of response_tokens on consumed_staleness events per optimizer step, split by staleness value. The trainer emits one event per consumed group, carrying its admitted staleness and token count. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

A sync run shows staleness 0 only.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Trainer/vLLM logprob mismatch ρ (staleness 0)
panels.description:
training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/staleness0/*: log-ratio mean/p99/p999, the fraction outside [0.5x, 2x], ESS fraction, KL and chi-squared, for staleness-zero loss tokens only. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics, isolating tokens with no policy drift since generation. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

A sync run shows staleness 0 only.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Trainer/vLLM logprob mismatch by staleness bucket
panels.description:
training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/staleness{0,1,2,3,4-7,8+}/log_ratio_abs_mean: mean absolute trainer/vLLM log-ratio by the group's staleness at consumption. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics from the same batch as the staleness-0 panel. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

A sync run shows staleness 0 only.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.description:
Fraction of consumed loss tokens (async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens) that fall in a batch eligible for the uniform-staleness table. Computed from the same training_metric_value rows, over the selected runs, jobs, executions and window. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; null means no tokens were observed.

A sync run shows staleness 0 only.

defaults.noValue: No valid token denominator

panels.title: Uniform-staleness diagnostic token coverage

panels.description:
Per-execution rollups of training_metric_value for optimizer batches whose async/staleness_min equals async/staleness_max: response length, token-weighted mean squared log-ratio, minimum ESS fraction and mean raw reward, one row per staleness value. Built from the same per-step metrics as the drift panels, restricted to uniform-staleness batches. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

A sync run shows staleness 0 only.

defaults.noValue: No matching diagnostics.

panels.title: Uniform-staleness batch diagnostics
vLLM token throughput
panels.description:
Prompt and generated tokens per second, summed across the run's inference engines.

A prompt-heavy ratio means prefill is being paid repeatedly. The prefix-cache panel says whether the cache is catching it.

Rates are differenced per engine from cumulative counters. Under GRPO all n samples of a group share one prompt, so a high prompt share is expected. Data from telemetry_v1.vllm, and from engines embedded in the trainer in telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No vLLM rows for this run. If the whole rank is blank, the engine exporter is down rather than six separate faults.

panels.title: vLLM queue and KV-cache usage
panels.description:
Requests running and queued in vLLM, with KV-cache usage on the right axis.

A growing queue with low KV-cache usage can suggest a scheduling or compute limit; high KV-cache usage and preemptions support cache pressure. Neither pattern alone identifies the cause or the right concurrency setting. A draining queue may be an intentional rollout boundary, not upstream starvation.

Values here are averaged across engines, unlike the fleet sums in Inference overview and diagnostics. Data from telemetry_v1.vllm, and from engines embedded in the trainer in telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No vLLM rows for this run. If the whole rank is blank, the engine exporter is down rather than six separate faults.

panels.title: vLLM request latency (mean by stage)
panels.description:
Mean seconds per finished request at each stage: queue, prefill, decode, time to first token, and end to end.

A rising decode stage means generation itself slowed. A rising queue stage means requests waited to start.

This is a mean and cannot show a tail; the straggler panel carries that. End to end and time to first token contain the other stages, so these series neither stack nor sum. Data from telemetry_v1.vllm, and from engines embedded in the trainer in telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No vLLM rows for this run. If the whole rank is blank, the engine exporter is down rather than six separate faults.

panels.title: vLLM KV-cache preemptions
panels.description:
Requests the engine evicted from its KV-cache and had to recompute, per time bucket.

Any value above zero means KV-cache pressure cost real work. High KV-cache occupancy with zero here cost nothing.

This is vLLM's own scheduler preemption. It is unrelated to Kubernetes pod preemption or Iris job preemption. Data from telemetry_v1.vllm, and from engines embedded in the trainer in telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No vLLM rows for this run. If the whole rank is blank, the engine exporter is down rather than six separate faults.

panels.title: Why vLLM requests finished
panels.description:
Finished engine requests per time bucket, split by the reason vLLM recorded.

A rising length share means responses are being truncated, and the verifier scores the truncation anyway.

The reason set is open; the pinned build emits stop, length, abort, error and repetition. One rollout is several requests when a group is sampled n ways. Blank means the engines finished nothing in this window. Data from telemetry_v1.vllm, and from engines embedded in the trainer in telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

panels.title: Prefix-cache hit rate
panels.description:
Cached prompt tokens divided by queried prompt tokens, across the run's inference engines.

A low rate with a prompt-heavy throughput ratio means prefill is being recomputed for prompts the engines already hold.

Both counters are in tokens, so this is not the share of requests that hit. Under GRPO all n samples of a group share one prompt. Data from telemetry_v1.vllm, and from engines embedded in the trainer in telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No vLLM rows for this run. If the whole rank is blank, the engine exporter is down rather than six separate faults.

panels.title: Megatron policy wall across ranks
panels.description:
Minimum, mean and maximum policy-update wall time across observed rank-steps in each bucket.

Megatron phases are CPU wall time around asynchronous CUDA launches (`clock_domain=cpu_dispatch_wall`), so a phase can end before its GPU work does.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Optimizer diagnostics
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/policy_entropy, policy/raw_grad_norm, policy/policy_kl, policy/final_loss and policy/policy_loss, one point per optimizer step. Logged by the policy worker after each optimizer_step call. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; these are different quantities and are not additive.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Megatron phase detail (newest 8 steps)
panels.description:
Each rank's newest eight observed steps across the selected executions, ordered by observation time. The table shows at most 5,000 phase rows.

Megatron phases are CPU wall time around asynchronous CUDA launches (`clock_domain=cpu_dispatch_wall`), so a phase can end before its GPU work does.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Learner memory by phase
panels.description: cuda_memory_observation for the policy worker: peak/reserved/allocated bytes and free device memory, by rank, GPU and phase. Recorded by LearnerMemory around each policy phase. Empty without trainer.policy_train_spans.

defaults.noValue: No matching observations

panels.title: GPU utilization on this run's nodes
panels.description:
Mean GPU busy percentage on the nodes this run occupied.

A long step with low GPU busy is stranded accelerator time. Read it beside the critical-path panel.

The node agent stamps no run id, so nodes are matched by name. Each node is credited to whichever run reported most from it in that bucket. A node shared by two runs goes entirely to one of them. Data from telemetry_v1.node_agent, joined to node names in telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: Zoom to 7h or less for GPU detail.

panels.title: SM and tensor-pipe activity on this run's nodes
panels.description:
DCGM SM-active and tensor-active on this run's nodes. High SM-active with near-zero tensor-active means kernels run but do little matrix math. Joined by node, so per-rank values are unavailable.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: Zoom to 7h or less for GPU detail.

panels.title: GPU memory in use on this run's nodes
panels.description:
DCGM framebuffer bytes, mean and peak across the run's GPUs. Per device, so it counts everything else on the card.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: Zoom to 7h or less for GPU detail.

panels.title: NVLink against PCIe receive traffic
panels.description:
DCGM NVLink and PCIe receive throughput, summed over the run's GPUs. NVLink traffic stayed within the NVLink domain; PCIe traffic left it. Neither shows the network beyond the host.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: Zoom to 7h or less for GPU detail.

panels.title: PCIe replay errors and power on this run's GPUs
panels.description:
GPUs with a positive increase in the PCIe replay counter, with peak board power in the selected window. After a counter reset, its new value counts as the increase.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

GPU detail is available for ranges of 7h or less; longer ranges show a zoom message.

defaults.noValue: No positive PCIe replay increase on this run's attributed GPUs in this window.

panels.title: Training reward and informative groups
panels.description: training_metric_value for reward/avg_raw_reward, reward/avg_pass_at_{n} and reward/informative_group_fraction, one point per optimizer step. Logged by the trainer from the reward-shaping and group-admission pass over each mini-batch. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Evaluation scores
panels.description: training_metric_value for every eval/% metric: held-out scores mirrored from the evaluation tracker. Written only at evaluation steps, one point per metric and execution. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; a blank between evaluation steps means no evaluation ran.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Length stops and coverage in trained groups
panels.description: training_metric_value for consumed/length_stop_fraction and consumed/stop_reason_coverage: the share of admitted response sequences that hit a length stop, gated on full stop-reason coverage. Logged by the trainer after the policy update consumes the batch. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; the fraction is null wherever coverage is incomplete.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Evaluation response length and stop coverage
panels.description: training_metric_value for eval/%/response_tokens_mean, response_tokens_max, length_stop_fraction, completed_stop_fraction and stop_reason_coverage. Logged by the trainer at each evaluation step from the finalized trajectories' stop reasons. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; fractions are blank wherever stop-reason coverage is incomplete.

defaults.noValue: No supplemental evaluation observations

panels.title: Evaluation score contributions by stop class
panels.description: training_metric_value for eval/%/avg_score, length_stop_score_contribution and completed_stop_score_contribution. Logged alongside the response-length panel at each evaluation step. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; the two contributions need not sum to avg_score.

defaults.noValue: No supplemental evaluation observations

panels.title: Pre-update model log-ratio drift
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/log_ratio_*: the trainer's pre-update logprob minus vLLM's recorded logprob, over finite loss tokens. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics in fwd_logprobs_values_reward, before the optimizer step consumes the batch. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Pre-update PPO-window pressure
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/lower_clip_pressure and upper_clip_pressure: the fraction of finite loss tokens outside the configured PPO ratio bounds. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics alongside the log-ratio drift metrics. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Drift coverage and token-weight concentration
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/finite_fraction, missing_behavior and ess_fraction: coverage and importance-weight concentration of the trainer/vLLM mismatch. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics from the same batch as the drift panels. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Mean squared model log-ratio
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/log_ratio_mean_squared: the mean squared trainer-minus-vLLM logprob difference over finite loss tokens. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics before the optimizer update. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Mean correction weight
panels.description: Mean off-policy correction weight over eligible tokens, including zero weights for masked tokens. The driver computes policy/correction/weight_mean after the old-policy forward and teacher-valid masking. Exported when trainer.training_metrics is enabled; absent when no correction is configured.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Correction activity
panels.description: Fractions of eligible tokens masked or truncated by the configured off-policy correction, and the policy loss clipping fraction. The driver emits policy/correction/{masked_fraction,truncated_fraction}; policy/ppo_clip_ratio comes from the learner. Exported when trainer.training_metrics is enabled. Correction series are absent when no correction is configured.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Trainer logprob drift within the update
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/log_ratio_*: the trainer's ratio against its own logprobs recomputed at consumption, pooled over the update's microbatches. Computed by LogRatioMonitor in the policy worker's training step, independent of the rollout-time mismatch panels. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Position dependence of |log ρ|
panels.description: training_metric_value for policy/mismatch/pooled/pos_* and policy/log_ratio_pos_*: mean absolute log-ratio by response position (first/last 256 tokens, middle) for the rollout-mismatch and within-update-drift families. Computed by mismatch_ratio_metrics and LogRatioMonitor. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Core and cycle duration
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/core_seconds, cycle_seconds and outside_core_seconds: the step's core wall and the surrounding cycle, including checkpoint/eval callbacks. Computed by async_step_metrics after each optimizer step. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Loss tokens trained per second
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/consumed_loss_tokens_per_core_second and per_cycle_second: useful loss tokens divided by core or cycle wall. Computed by async_step_metrics alongside the core/cycle durations. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Core wall fractions
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/buffer_wait_fraction, training_fraction and weight_sync_fraction: the driver's core wall split across waiting for a full admitted batch, run_training and sync_weights. Computed by async_step_metrics from the same step timings as Core and cycle duration. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Useful tokens per configured role GPU-second
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/loss_tokens_per_configured_policy_gpu_second and response_tokens_per_configured_inference_gpu_second. Computed by async_step_metrics from consumed work divided by the configured policy and inference GPU counts; it does not measure vLLM engine utilization. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Configured role GPU counts
panels.description: training_metric_value for async/performance/configured_policy_gpus and configured_inference_gpus: policy nodes x GPUs/node, and inference engines x TP x PP x DP. Computed by async_step_metrics from trainer.placement and the generator config. Empty without trainer.training_metrics.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Cumulative core GPU-hours in selected window
panels.description: Running sum of async/performance/core_seconds times configured policy+inference GPUs, divided by 3600, accumulated over complete rows in the window. Computed by async_step_metrics per optimizer step, cumulative within each execution. Empty without trainer.training_metrics; excludes startup, eval, checkpoint and export time.

defaults.noValue: No matching records in this window.

panels.title: Ray object store occupancy
panels.description:
Share of the Ray object store in use across the run's nodes.

Climbing toward 1 means the store is about to spill. Spill shows up as rollout latency before it shows up as a failure.

The ratio is used divided by used plus free, so it does not move when the node count does. This is Ray plumbing and is unrelated to the engines' KV-cache. Ray produces these counters; MarinSkyRL scrapes them into telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No Ray rows for this run. Non-Ray deployment, or the Ray metric bridge is off.

panels.title: Ray spill bytes
panels.description:
Bytes the Ray spill manager holds, averaged across the run's nodes and split by state.

A pending-spill line that stops draining means the spill path has stalled. A spilled line that steepens means trajectories are bigger than budgeted.

The states are separate quantities. Pinned, pending spill and pending restore are current occupancy. Spilled and restored are lifetime totals and only climb. Ray produces these counters; MarinSkyRL scrapes them into telemetry_v1.marinskyrl.

Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No Ray rows for this run. Non-Ray deployment, or the Ray metric bridge is off.
